Hi, I'm the Head of Product at PayStream. We're about to go into our first external security audit next month and the auditors have asked us to provide a formal security risk document for our real-time payment platform.

Our engineering team has put together some architecture notes, docs, and design files under the `paystream/` folder in the workspace. I need you to read through all of that material and produce a comprehensive, structured security threat model document for the platform.

The document should cover the full picture: what we're protecting and where our security perimeter is, a diagram showing how data moves through our system, a systematic analysis of threats across our key components (covering at least spoofing, tampering, repudiation, data exposure, availability, and privilege issues), a hierarchical breakdown of how an attacker might actually achieve the worst-case scenario, a risk-scored and prioritized list of the top threats (using a scoring method that gives a numeric rating for each of five risk dimensions and produces a final risk level), what we plan to do about each risk versus what we're consciously accepting, and when this document should be revisited.

Please save the final document as `paystream_threat_model.md`.
